description: Focused LLM review repair for aggregation where regex safety and scenario-overlay operator parity.

userStories.title: Harden Aggregation Where Safety and Scenario Parity
userStories.description: As an operations analyst using Aggregation with saved filters and scenario overlays, I want aggregate where clauses to honor the platform's regex safety boundary and text-operator semantics, so aggregate requests cannot bypass regex protections or silently drop valid scenario-overlay results.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an aggregate request includes a where clause with the regex operator
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is rejected with a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT response instead of executing an unbounded Bleve aggregation search

acceptanceCriteria.given: a scenario-overlay aggregate request includes a where clause with containsAnyTerm
acceptanceCriteria.when: scenario edits are folded over base rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: the in-memory overlay aggregation filters the post-overlay rows with the same UI-supported operator before metrics and groupBy buckets are computed

acceptanceCriteria.given: a scenario-overlay aggregate request includes a where operator that the in-memory matcher does not support
acceptanceCriteria.when: the handler validates the scenario aggregate request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is rejected with a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT response instead of silently returning an empty aggregate
